pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with relatively smooth pixel gradients at the edges. Patch spatial area is larger on the upper flank and decreases in size toward the posterior limb.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored pathways forming a grid. Junction nodes primarily consist of tri-radial intersections with thin, consistent pixel thickness throughout the visible flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A low-frequency, jagged silhouette is visible at the superior margin of the neck and back, exhibiting small vertical amplitude against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small avian symbiont perched on the upper dorsal ridge.
